heading: Chap. viii.—Persevere in hope and patience.
paragraphs:
Let us then continually persevere in our hope, and the
earnest of our righteousness, which is Jesus Christ, “who
bore our sins in His own body on the tree,”[362] “who did no
sin, neither was guile found in His mouth,”[363] but endured all
things for us, that we might live in Him.[364] Let us then be
imitators of His patience; and if we suffer[365] for His name’s
sake, let us glorify Him.[366] For He has set us this example[367]
in Himself, and we have believed that such is the case.
